description.narrative: The 2023 Committee on the Application of Standards (CAS) called on the Government of North Macedonia to seek ILO technical assistance to ensure full compliance with Convention No. 98. The CAS conclusions focused on six key aspects: 1. Protection against anti-union discrimination 2. Protection of workers' and employers' organizations from interference 3. Compliance of legislative reforms with Convention No. 98 4. Compliance with collective agreements in force 5. Proper functioning of the Commission for representativeness, particularly regarding the Confederation of Free Trade Unions of Macedonia (KSS) 6. Evolution of collective bargaining in practice Building on previous ILO support (2022–2023), which contributed to an advanced draft of the Labour Relations Law, an adopted Action Plan of the Economic and Social Council (ESC), and ratification of Conventions 190 and 160, the ILO further assists North Macedonia in aligning its labour and industrial relations framework with international labour standards and EU accession requirements. Key areas of support: (a) Labour law reform: the ILO provides technical assistance to reform the Labour Relations Law, in collaboration with the Macedonian Labour Law Association, and facilitate expert discussions within the ESC. (b) Promotion of labour rights: activities include translating and publishing key ILO documents, organizing seminars for judges, prosecutors, trade unions, employers, government officials, and youth, and enhancing legal resources through the Labour Law website. (c) Strengthening social dialogue: the ILO supports ESC discussions on CEACR comments, facilitate labour law conferences, and engage parliamentarians in labour law reform debates. These efforts will contribute to strengthening freedom of association, collective bargaining, and effective dispute resolution mechanisms in North Macedonia.
